chunks.arabic_text: الكَافِي: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ الْمَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ، عَن أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Al-Kafi: Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Mansur ibn Hazm, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ: مُجَالَسَةُ أَهْلِ الدِّينِ شَرَفُ الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ

translations.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Sitting with the people of religion is an honour in the world and the hereafter.

en.summary: This hadith emphasizes the spiritual and social value of associating with those who are devout and knowledgeable in their faith. It teaches that companionship with the pious brings dignity and status in both this life and the afterlife.
en.seo_question: What is the benefit of sitting with people of religion according to Shia hadith?
